source: docs/work-orders/2026-10-17-onyx-mizan.md Task 3; quotes verbatim from kb/chunks (check with python -m onyx check-data)

verbs.quote: Licensees shall not register, charge or otherwise avail a Service to a Subscriber that the Subscriber has not expressly ordered or opted to pay for.
verbs.note: Confirmed at the keys session 2026-10-21 (Fable): 4.3 (no Service without an express order) and 4.7.1 (opt-in by positive affirmative action) are the clauses a sale hangs on; the channel sub-article (4.17, 4.22, 4.23) comes from classify_channel.

verbs.quote: The provisions of sub-article 4.3 shall not apply in circumstances where an existing Service
verbs.note: Confirmed at the keys session 2026-10-21 (Fable): 4.4 (renewal exception, three conditions tested not the label), 4.9 (no upgrade or migration without consent) and 66/2023 34(5) (unilateral change void except a notified upgrade).

verbs.quote: the Licensee shall disclose it free of charge and without delay after an adequate verification process
verbs.note: Confirmed at the keys session 2026-10-21 (Fable): 24.10 is the only clause on disclosure to the Subscriber; its 'adequate verification process' is gap 3 (S5 step 4).

verbs.quote: preclude the use of non-human agents by Licensees in conversations with Consumers regarding Consumer Complaints
verbs.note: Confirmed at the keys session 2026-10-21 (Fable): order Task 6: in a complaint the AI may draft_reply for the human only; 26.7.2 and licence 9.1 are the two sources of the human requirement (hq telecom read, gap 2).

verbs.quote: The following conditions shall apply in circumstances where the purchase of a Licensee provided Service3 is made via a Licensee App:
all information provided to Consumers shall, at the time it is provided, be complete, transparent, accurate, and truthful
verbs.note: Confirmed at the keys session 2026-10-21 (Fable): 3.3 (information complete, accurate, truthful) is the duty a verbatim citation serves; no clause names citation itself. Method basis: the order's global constraint 'every mandate verb cites a KB row'.

verbs.quote: an MLFO is a logical node with functionalities that manage and orchestrate the nodes of ML pipelines
verbs.note: Confirmed at the keys session 2026-10-21 (Fable): method basis only (Y.3172 8.1 MLFO); no binding clause governs flagging a gap, and none is claimed.

verbs.quote: the Licensee shall resolve the Dispute and respond to the TDRA within three (3) business days
verbs.note: Confirmed at the keys session 2026-10-21 (Fable): 26.16.1 (three business days) and licence 9.3 (TDRA Customer Dispute Resolution).

verbs.quote: the TDRA may direct the concerned Licensee to restore a Consumer’s service in whole or in part
verbs.note: Changed at the keys session 2026-10-21 (Fable): CPR 26.11 is the clause that lets the TDRA direct restoration (the 2026-10-20 mapping cited licence 9.3 alone, which only says the TDRA may resolve the dispute); 9.3 kept as the licence-level basis.

verbs.quote: shall furnish this information to the TDRA in a format and timeframe determined by the TDRA
verbs.note: Confirmed at the keys session 2026-10-21 (Fable): licence 9.2.4 (complaint records furnished in the TDRA's format and timeframe) and CPR 3.9 (copies of records to the TDRA on demand).

verbs.quote: The Data Subject shall have the right to object to any decisions resulting from automated processing
If the processing includes a systematic and comprehensive assessment of the personal aspects of the Data Subject, using automated processing
The Controller shall include the human element in reviewing automated processing decisions at the request of the Data Subject.
an MLFO is a logical node with functionalities that manage and orchestrate the nodes of ML pipelines
verbs.note: Confirmed at the keys session 2026-10-21 (Fable): method basis only (Y.3172 8.1: MLFO stage schedule for release_event, D node for route); no binding clause governs it, and none is claimed.

verbs.quote: This node is responsible for identifying the SINK(s) and distributing the output of the M node to the corresponding SINK nodes.
verbs.note: Confirmed at the keys session 2026-10-21 (Fable): method basis only (Y.3172 8.1: MLFO stage schedule for release_event, D node for route); no binding clause governs it, and none is claimed.

verbs.quote: preclude the use of non-human agents by Licensees in conversations with Consumers regarding Consumer Complaints
verbs.note: Confirmed at the keys session 2026-10-21 (Fable): 26.7.2 and licence 9.1 (a human for complaint conversations), PDPL 18(4) (human review of an automated decision on request); also the deny-by-default fallback when a verb has no gate (design basis IMDA 2.2.2, in reasons only).

keys_session: 2026-10-21 (Fable): every 2026-10-20 design mapping checked; one changed (tdra.order_restore to CPR 26.11), three widened (propose_change +4.9, raise_dispute +licence 9.3, request_report +CPR 3.9).
